qualifications: exposure at least one Cloud Exposure (Azure / AWS)

form.descriptionPreview:

4+ years MS SQL Server Administration experience required
Strong experience in High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) options for SQL Server (installation and

Experience with backups, restores and recovery models
Experience with troubleshoot large scale Always ON and Distributed Always On (DAG) environments.
Should be able to handle 24 x 7 rotational support including night shifts.
Advanced knowledge of SSAS, SSIS, and SSRS

source_preview:
MSSQL DBA – L2

Skill and qualification

·
4+ years MS SQL Server Administration experience required
·
Strong experience in High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) options for SQL Server (installation and
troubleshoot)
·
Experience with backups, restores and recovery models
·
Experience with troubleshoot large scale Always ON and Distributed Always On (DAG) environments.
·
Should be able to handle 24 x 7 rotational support including night shifts.
·
Advanced knowledge of SSAS, SSIS, and SSRS
·
Must have exposure at least one Cloud Exposure (Azure / AWS)
·
Hands on experience with clustering platforms for large scale environment.
·
Troubleshoot application sluggishness and poor performance (including execution plans understanding)
·
MCSE/MCSA certificates preferred
·
Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server infrastructures
·
Understanding of Migration and upgrade of various SQL server versions in place + other environment.
·
Excellent written and verbal communication
·
Download and install SQL Server service packs and updates.
